researchAgent.title: Research agent
researchAgent.subtitle: Give the agent an instruction — it builds deliverables (summary, breakdown, theme ranking) exclusively from this synthesis. No speculation, no fabrication.
researchAgent.notReady: Once the synthesis is created, the agent can build deliverables from it.
researchAgent.placeholder: e.g. "Summarize the main findings as 5 bullet points" or "Which 3 themes matter most?"
researchAgent.anchoredHint: Every deliverable is anchored exclusively in this synthesis — unsupported claims are dropped.
researchAgent.errEngine: The research agent is currently unavailable.

missionControl.pageIntro: Ask a question ACROSS ALL studies in your organization — answers come exclusively from the study syntheses, with a source citation per study.
missionControl.title: Ask across studies
missionControl.subtitle: Ask across all of your organization's study syntheses. Every statement is anchored to a verbatim quote from the study it cites — when there's no evidence you get an honest refusal instead of a fabricated answer.
missionControl.notReady: Once at least one study has been synthesized, you can ask across studies here.
missionControl.placeholder: e.g. "Which themes appear across studies?" or "Compare the findings from study A and B."
missionControl.anchoredHint: Every answer is anchored exclusively in the study syntheses — unsupported claims are dropped.
missionControl.errNoAccess: No access — please sign in and select an organization.

crossStudyAgent.chatHint: Chat — quickly answers a question across all study syntheses at once. For deeper research (selective loading, exact counting, comparison) switch to the Agent.
crossStudyAgent.agentHint: Agent — researches in multiple steps: loads the relevant studies on demand, counts themes exactly (e.g. "in how many studies …") and compares. More thorough, but slower than Chat.
crossStudyAgent.title: Cross-Study agent
crossStudyAgent.subtitle: The agent researches across studies — it loads the relevant studies on demand, counts themes exactly, and compares. Every statement is anchored to a verbatim quote per study; anything it can't ground it labels as interpretation or honestly declines.
crossStudyAgent.notReady: Once at least one study has been synthesized, the agent can research here.
crossStudyAgent.placeholder: e.g. "In how many studies does the onboarding theme appear?" or "Compare the pricing findings across studies."
crossStudyAgent.anchoredHint: Grounded statements are anchored per study; numbers come from exact counting. Anything not grounded appears separately as interpretation.
crossStudyAgent.errNoAccess: No access — please sign in and select an organization.
crossStudyAgent.errEngine: The cross-study agent is currently unavailable.
